title: The pointwise limit of currents with uniform local sup-norm bounds is a current and their weak limit
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and S_i ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n, i ∈ ℕ); ‖·‖ is the operator norm on Covector (Euclid P) n. Assume (a) for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P there is a real c ≥ 0 with |S_i(ω)| ≤ c·s for all i ∈ ℕ, all ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P) (TestFormOn univ n) with tsupport ω ⊆ K and all s ∈ ℝ with ‖ω(x)‖ ≤ s for every x; and (b) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P) the real sequence (S_i(ω))_{i∈ℕ} converges. Then there is C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n) with S_i ⇀ C, i.e. S_i(ω) → C(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P) (WeaklyConvergesOn S C).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (S : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → ∃ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c ∧ ∀ (i : ℕ) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (s : ℝ), tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ K → (∀ x, ‖(ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x‖ ≤ s) → |S i ω| ≤ c * s) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, ∃ L : ℝ, Tendsto (fun i => S i ω) atTop (𝓝 L)) → ∃ C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, WeaklyConvergesOn S C
